providers.retention: Only files deleted in the last 30 days can be recovered, through Recently Deleted and Data Recovery on iCloud.com. That is a recovery window for deleted files, not a history of earlier versions of a file. Document versions some Mac apps keep are stored on the Mac, not by iCloud Drive.
providers.notes: Apple's pages describe recovering deleted files within 30 days and say nothing about earlier versions of a file that still exists. A recovery window for deleted files is not version history.

providers.retention: Old versions are kept for 30 days on Basic, Plus and Family plans, and 180 days on Professional and Essentials.
Old versions of uploaded files are kept for 30 days or until 100 newer versions exist, unless a version is marked to keep forever.
Personal accounts keep the last 25 versions. Work and school accounts follow the organization's settings.
providers.notes: Work or school accounts depend on admin settings; treated as versioned.

providers.retention: Personal Pro keeps 10 versions; the free plan keeps only 1, which is no history.
